title: Towards the Vision-Sound-Language-Action Paradigm: The HEAR Framework for Sound-Centric Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2603.16086v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: While recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have begun to incorporate audio, they typically treat sound as static pre-execution prompts or focus exclusively on human speech. This leaves a significant gap in real-time, sound-centric manipulation where fleeting environmental acoustics provide critical state verification during task execution. Consequently, key sounds are easily missed due to low-frequency updates or system latency. This problem is exacerbated by action chunking with open-loop execution, which creates a Blind Execution Interval where acoustic events are lost between discrete audio observation windows. translated_title: 迈向视觉-声音-语言-动作范式：以声音为中心操作的HEAR框架
translated_abstract: 尽管近期的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已开始引入音频，但它们通常将声音视为执行前的静态提示，或仅专注于人类语音。这在实时、以声音为中心的操作中留下了显著空白——在这类任务中，转瞬即逝的环境声学信号可在任务执行期间提供关键的状态验证。因此，由于低频更新或系统延迟，关键声音很容易被遗漏。采用开环执行的动作分块进一步加剧了这一问题，它造成了“盲执行区间”，使得声学事件在离散的音频观测窗口之间丢失。认识到持续听觉感知的必要性，我们将视觉-声音-语言-动作（VSLA）形式化为一种连续控制范式，该范式在延迟决策循环下以视觉、流式音频、语言和本体感觉为条件。作为实例化，我们提出了HEAR，一个集成四……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文将视觉-声音-语言-动作（VSLA）形式化为一种在延迟决策循环下基于视觉、流式音频、语言和本体感觉的连续控制范式，并提出HEAR框架，通过持续听觉感知解决声音中心操作中因动作分块开环执行导致的“盲执行区间”内声学事件丢失的问题。
en_tdlr: The paper formalizes the Vision-Sound-Language-Action (VSLA) paradigm as continuous control conditioned on vision, streaming audio, language, and proprioception, and introduces HEAR, a framework enabling continuous auditory awareness to overcome acoustic event loss in "Blind Execution Intervals" during sound-centric manipulation.
